name: Your Other Half
source:
Your friend has gone missing. 

They were someone you met through your university's newspaper committee. The last conversation you had with them was intimate, heartfelt, and ended up in you accidentally casting them to the wayside. 

You try your best not to let your regret consume you, but it does. You forget about your own wellbeing, your responsibilities, your relationships —  even the feelings of your own best friend.

[From [url=https://miaomarue.itch.io/your-other-half]itch.io[/url]]
